与疾病、恶作剧以及有害或危险的魔法影响相关的超自然生物或精灵；在后来的北欧文献中，有时分为善的 light elves (住在 Álfheimr) 和惡的 dark elves。

examples.text: The elfs or elves were inhabitants of the fields and groves, the progenitors of the fairies of the middle ages; […]
examples.translation: 精灵是田野和树林的居民，是中世纪仙子的祖先； […]

examples.text: The man whom heauens haue ordaynd to bee / The ſpouſe of Britomart, is Arthegall: / He wonneth in the land of Fayeree, / Yet is no Fary borne, ne ſib at all / To Elfes, but ſprong of ſeed terreſtriall, / And whylome by falſe Faries ſtolne away, / Whyles yet in infant cradle he did crall; / Ne other to himſelfe is knowne this day, / But that he by an Elfe was gotten of a Fay.
examples.translation: 那位天命所归、注定要成为 / 布里托玛特夫君的人，便是阿特加尔：/ 他如今在仙境中征战立业，/ 然而他并非生于仙族，/与精灵也毫无血缘亲属关系；/他本是出自尘世凡人的血脉，/昔日却曾被狡诈的仙子偷掳而去，/那时他尚在襁褓之中、爬卧于摇篮里；/直到今日，他自己也不知道自己的真实身世，/只以为自己乃是一位精灵与一位仙子所生。

examples.text: Their Robbin-good-fellowes, Elfes, Fairies, Hobgoblins of our latter age, which idolatrous former daies and the fantasticall world of Greece ycleaped Fawnes, Satyres, Dryades & Hamadryades, did most of their merry prankes in the Night.
examples.translation: 我们今日所谓的罗宾善伙伴、精灵、仙子与霍布哥布林，正是昔日异教时代以及充满奇幻想象的希腊世界所称的牧神、萨堤尔、树精和林木仙女；他们大多都在夜晚施行那些嬉戏捉弄人的把戏。

examples.text: Every elf, and fairy sprite, / Hop as light as bird from brier.
examples.translation: 每个精灵和仙子，/ 都像鸟儿一样轻盈地从荆棘丛中跳出。

examples.text: […] I had rather have a Child which my Wife ſhould bring me, though by another man, then to have a Changeling brought me by a company of Fairies, Elfs and Goblins: […]
examples.translation: […] 我宁愿妻子为我生一个孩子，哪怕是和别的男人所生，也不愿被一群仙子、精灵和哥布林换来一个孩子： […]

examples.text: The quarrel ſpreading into parties, called the Guelfs and the Gibellines, became at laſt the wonder and amazement of all good people: inſomuch as ſome are of opinion, that the fiction of the Elfs and Goblins, wherewith we uſe to fright young children, was derived from hence.
examples.translation: 这场纷争逐渐演变为两个派别，即圭尔夫派和吉伯林派之间的对立，最终竟成为所有善良正直之人惊异而震骇的话题：以至于有人认为，我们用来吓唬小孩的精灵和哥布林传说就是由此而演变来。

examples.text: The opinion of Fairies and Elfs is very old, and yet ſticketh very religiously in the minds of ſome. But to root that rank opinion of Elfs out of mens hearts, the truth is, that there be no ſuch things, nor yet the ſhadows of the things, but only by a ſort of bald Friers and knaviſh ſhavelings ſo faigned; […]
examples.translation: 关于仙子和精灵的信仰由来已久，而且直到如今，仍有一些人对此深信不疑。然而，为了将人们心中这种根深蒂固的精灵信仰彻底铲除，我在这里要说的事实是：世上根本不存在这类东西，甚至连它们的影子都不存在；这一切不过是一帮秃顶的修士和狡诈无赖的剃发僧侣凭空捏造出来的罢了； […]

examples.text: […]the Devaſtations under the Goths, Guelphs, and Gibelines [whence ſome would derive the Terms of Elfs (or Elves) or Fairies, and Goblins (or Hobgoblins) or Spectres, &c.] […]
examples.translation: […] 哥特人、归尔甫人和吉伯林人统治下的蹂躏[由此衍生出精灵（Elfs 或 Elves）、仙女（Fairies）、哥布林（Goblins 或 Hobgoblins）或幽灵（Spectres）等词] […]

examples.text: Here in the interior the saga placed the descendants of the demons (Troll) and elves (Alfvar), more hateful than all other men.
examples.translation: 传说中，这片内陆地区居住着恶魔（Troll）和精灵（Alfvar）的后裔，他们比所有其他人类都更加可憎。

examples.text: These Picts are the Clan Alpin, the Alps, or Elfs or Elves,—[…]
examples.translation: 这些皮克特人是亚尔宾王朝，也就是阿尔卑斯山人，或者叫精灵族，—— […]

examples.text: The Arbhus became in Teutonic mythology the Alben, Elben or Elfen, our Elfs, and in Scandinavian the Alfar.
examples.translation: 在日耳曼神话中，阿尔布胡斯变成了阿尔本、埃尔本或埃尔芬，也就是我们所说的精灵；而在斯堪的纳维亚神话中，它变成了阿尔法尔。

examples.text: Eve, Danish legend of her concealing her unwashed children, from whom come elfs, trolls, &c.
examples.translation: 夏娃，丹麦传说中她藏匿了自己未受洗的孩子，精灵、巨魔等都是她的后代。

examples.text: NAT,[…]; a term applied to all spiritual beings, angels, elfs, demons, or what not, including the gods of the Hindus.
examples.translation: Nat（纳）， […] 一个适用于一切灵性存在的总称，包括天使、精灵、恶魔等等，乃至印度教诸神亦包含在内。

examples.text: Elfs and fays, from their haunts in the mountains, whistle their eerie ballads above the gray roof of “Dove Cottage,” and dance their ghostly jigs on the huge hearthstone, among whose blazing logs the Fire God paints his immortal canvases, with colorings splendid beyond the dream of man.
examples.translation: 精灵和仙子从山中的巢穴里，在“鸽舍”灰色的屋顶上吹着诡异的歌谣，在巨大的炉石上跳着幽灵般的吉格舞，火神在燃烧的木柴间绘制着他不朽的画作，色彩绚丽，超乎人类的想象。

examples.text: Alfs [elfs]: Another name for the elfs or elves.
examples.translation: 精灵（Alfs）：精灵或小精灵的另一个名称。

examples.text:
Cain got no good from committing that murder
because the Almighty made him anathema
and out of the curse of his exile there sprang
ogres and elves and evil phantoms[.]
examples.translation:
该隐并未因犯下那场谋杀而得到任何益处，
因为全能的上帝使他受到了诅咒，
而从他被放逐所受的咒诅之中，
诞生了食人魔、精灵以及种种邪恶的妖魔鬼怪。

glosses: 一种类似小仙子的小型魔法生物，通常顽皮、爱玩，偶尔也会乐于助人

examples.text: For there and ſeveral other places / About mill dams and green brae faces, / Both Elrich, Elfs and Brownies ſtayed, / And Green gown’d Farries daunc’d and played; […]
examples.translation: 因为在那里，以及其他几处地方，磨坊水坝四周与青翠的山坡之上，都栖息着厄尔里奇、精灵和布朗尼；而身着绿色长袍的仙子则在那里翩翩起舞，嬉戏游乐； […]

examples.text: Farefolkis, fairies, elfs, or elves; […]
examples.translation: 妖精、仙子、精灵； […]

examples.text: The next species of these airy nothings are the elfs, or elves; […]
examples.translation: 接下来要介绍的这些轻盈的小家伙们，就叫做精灵； […]

examples.text: We may add, and our author has knowledge of the fact, that not even the Germans, those masterly delineators and imaginators of fairy-land, have shown greater or more exquisite insight into the lives and ways of elfs and fays than that which was shown by George Cruikshank.
examples.translation: 我们还可以补充一点——而且我们的作者对此事实也是知晓的——即便是德国人，那些描绘和构想仙境（fairy-land）的大家，也未曾比乔治·克鲁克香克展现出更高明、更精妙的洞察力，去把握精灵和仙子的生活与习性。

examples.text: All the fairy tales of my childhood were conjured up before my startled imagination, and appeared to be realised in the forms which surrounded me; I saw the whole forest filled with trolls, elves, and sporting dwarfs.
examples.translation: 我童年时所有的童话故事都浮现在我惊愕的想象中，并且似乎以各种形式在我周围变成现实；我看到整个森林里到处都是巨魔、精灵和嬉戏的矮人。

glosses: 精灵（身材高挑、纤细优雅、长着尖耳朵的种族，通常不死或非常长寿，并且拥有智慧和魔法能力）

examples.text: Much of fairy lore clusters around the so-called fairy rings, that is, the green circles in old pastures within which the elfs were supposed to dance at night by the light of the moon.
examples.translation: 许多关于仙女的传说都围绕着所谓的仙女圈，也就是古老牧场上的绿色圆圈来展开，据说精灵们会在月光下于其中跳舞。

examples.text: He was not speaking troll-talk now, but the language of Elfland, that grander tongue that he had had to speak when he was before the King: for he knew the language of Elfland although it was never used in the homes of the trolls, who preferred troll-talk. This language was spoken in those days also by men, for there were fewer languages then, and the elves and the people of Erl both used the same.
examples.translation: 他现在说的不是巨魔语，而是精灵语，那种他觐见国王时必须说的、更为高贵的语言：因为他懂精灵语，尽管巨魔们从不用这种语言，他们更喜欢巨魔语。在那个时代，人类也说这种语言，因为那时语言种类较少，精灵和厄尔的人民都使用同一种语言。

examples.text: So they laughed and sang in the trees; and pretty fair nonsense I daresay you think it. Not that they would care they would only laugh all the more if you told them so. They were elves of course. Soon Bilbo caught glimpses of them as the darkness deepened. He loved elves, though he seldom met them; but he was a little frightened of them too.
examples.translation: 于是他们在树上又唱又笑；我敢说，你肯定觉得他们胡说八道。不过他们才不会在意呢，你要是说了，他们只会笑得更厉害。他们当然是精灵。夜色渐深，比尔博渐渐瞥见了他们的身影。虽然很少见到精灵，但他很喜欢他们，不过同时也有点害怕他们。

examples.text: Fantasy elves have human shapes. They're thin. They're tall. They're beautiful. They're blond. They have pointy ears.
examples.translation: 奇幻世界中的精灵拥有人类的外形。他们身材纤细，高挑，美丽动人，金发碧眼，长着尖尖的耳朵。

glosses: Christmas elf的缩略形式。

examples.text: Since you’ve been out, the news arrives / The Elfs’ Insurance Company’s gone.
examples.translation: 你离开后，消息传来/[圣诞]精灵保险公司倒闭了。
